statements.statement: Last year's roughly one-million-dollar override went entirely to the school budget and stays there, compounding annually.
Of 351 Massachusetts cities and towns, 16 including Lunenburg passed a school-designated override last year.
The town skipped funding stabilization this year and is effectively drawing down reserves for one year rather than following best fiscal practice.
Chapter 70 aid has grown only about 1.3% per year for the last four years.
A member said the school budget seems to need a 20% increase year-over-year just to maintain the same level of service.
At least $120,000 of the roughly $948,000 override passed for schools will go to cover the FY25 athletic revolving account deficit.
The reduced-scope Marshall Park warrant article is priced at about $30 million.
